title: Nourishing Juicy German Sausage Bowl
description: A hearty and adventurous German dish featuring juicy sausage, mustardy flavors, and porridge oats, served in a traditional stone-bowl-dolsot, perfect for a low-carb friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the stone-bowl-dolsot over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the unsalted butter to the preheated stone-bowl-dolsot and let it melt.
Add the German sausage links to the stone-bowl-dolsot and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Remove the cooked sausage from the stone-bowl-dolsot and set aside.
Add the porridge oats to the stone-bowl-dolsot and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, stone-ground mustard, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper to the stone-bowl-dolsot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the oats are tender.
Stir in the sauerkraut and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the cooked sausage to the stone-bowl-dolsot and serve hot.
